summary: Android API contract endpoints tested. All 4 config endpoints return 200 with valid JSON containing required keys. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Privacy/deletion endpoint paths in Android API contract are incorrect - documented as /api/user/account/* but actual endpoints are at /api/account/*.

critical.issue: Path mismatch: privacy_and_account_deletion in Android config documents endpoints at /api/user/account/* but actual working endpoints are at /api/account/*. This will cause 404 errors for Android clients following the documented contract.
fix_options: Option 1: Update _android_api_contract_payload() in user.py to return correct paths /api/account/*
Option 2: Add duplicate endpoints at /api/user/account/* paths to match documentation

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Update Android API contract to document correct endpoint paths (/api/account/* instead of /api/user/account/*) OR add endpoints at documented paths
critical_code_review_comments: In user.py line 52-54, _android_api_contract_payload() returns incorrect paths for privacy endpoints
The user router has no prefix, so endpoints defined as /account/* become /api/account/* not /api/user/account/*
ANDROID_API_CONTRACT.md also documents incorrect paths - needs update

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The user router in user.py is included without a prefix in server.py (line 97: api_router.include_router(user_router)). Endpoints defined as @router.get('/account/export') become /api/account/export, not /api/user/account/export. However, _android_api_contract_payload() hardcodes paths with /api/user/ prefix.
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Update _android_api_contract_payload() in user.py lines 52-54 to return correct paths: /api/account/export, /api/account/delete-request, /api/account/deletion-status
